signed_rows.behavior: ci.yml runs on every pull request and on every push to main
signed_rows.fails_when: ci.yml is missing, or its on: block lacks pull_request or a push trigger limited to main

signed_rows.behavior: ci.yml's knowledge job runs kmctl's own check with uses: ./ after a full-history checkout
signed_rows.fails_when: no job has a uses: ./ step, or its checkout lacks fetch-depth: 0

signed_rows.behavior: ci.yml's prek job runs uvx prek at the version justfile pins, on all files
signed_rows.fails_when: no job runs uvx prek@<the justfile's version> run --all-files

signed_rows.behavior: ci.yml's tests job runs the default test suite with uv run pytest
signed_rows.fails_when: no job runs uv run pytest, or it passes a -m that changes the default tier

signed_rows.behavior: every action in ci.yml is pinned by commit SHA and setup-uv runs with its cache off
signed_rows.fails_when: a uses: other than ./ is not a 40-character SHA, or a setup-uv step lacks enable-cache: false

signed_rows.behavior: knowledge.yml is gone, so kmctl check runs once per pull request
the install how-to quotes only workflows this repository ships, naming ci.yml's knowledge job instead of knowledge.yml
signed_rows.fails_when: a .github/workflows/ path in the how-to's 'quoted from' note or its step 4 'shipped' sentence does not exist in the repository
